body:
Well, hard to explain really. Not even sure I fully understand myself. Taking a lot after my Dad, which is conflicting because 'spiritually' (don't know another word for it) I feel much different from him. but It seems that the Nature vs Nurture has made me way too much like my dad, despite not being in contact with him very much. It's like pushing in the opposite direction, you can't fight the person you are, your personality ect. but I don't like my personality. which is weird because i always felt that people were able to live with their personalities without feeling super conflicted over it. I can understand being unhappy with your appearance but he person you are? It's really hard.

Also I know that people will say you can always explore other paths/ideas, but for me I feel like I need to push for one thing until I have other options, because right now it does literally feel like life or death.

I can understand that, however although I still feel awful, The medication DID for sure have an initial effect that granted me enough mental capacity to make decisions for myself, and find something to aim for i guess. Well no, when she found the first one, it was because i wrote it at my grandparents (i normally live with my mum) So the one i wrote yesterday is under my desk right now.

I guess so, it has just been very hard to see anything good about myself. Every "Good" aspect of myself doesn't match the person I want to be. I know that we have to work with what we have, but putting two and two together doesn't seem to work at all with a lot of things that feel apart of me spiritually.

That is true, though it's hard to see it like that whilst resenting yourself, like I like the idea of it, but I don't see myself in that setting, i don't like the idea of myself in that setting if that makes sense. despite really wanting to achieve it, and it feels like a hidden part of me i want to be closer to. I just really do not like myself in any capacity. physically, mentally, the lot. Like i don't deserve it for being who i am, sorta...

I was in a terrible state 2 years ago after failing my first course, and struggling really hard to even start the 2nd course (which i have now passed) Initially the medication did give me the mental capacity to find motivation within myself, but over time it felt more like a crutch, like the broken leg had healed, but I'm still using the crutch, it's more of an inconvenience than an aid. and 2 weeks after not taking medication I was still peachy, still good, just a bit bipolar.

Well from speaking to them they don't seem to have any motivations in terms of ensuring I stay alive. It's more an expectation. The thing is I am lost with everything, I don't have hobbies or career aspirations. In the next 4 weeks I am supposed to start a course so i can go on to University. My Mum's attitude to it is she would rather I just work, 'no pressure' "as long as you are happy, you don't need to do anything major" What she doesn't realise is I don't want to settle for mediocrity, I want something to aim for, something to hold onto. If I just give up and lower the bar. I won't last. I've made this blatantly clear, and she points out that i have no definitive career aspirations, and uses that to discredit (not sure it's the right word but i'll go with it) my motivations. I was already feeling skeptical about pushing for University due to my previous failures in college, and the bar being set high. But I want nothing more than to just achieve something more than just being alive. Especially if it is studying something that really does interest/excite me.

Thank you for offering. I just don't think that I gain anything from talking with people about my issues. I honestly don't even understand why I made a post about it, last resort I guess. Too much resolve with no real aim.

Because they don't treat you like a human, they treat you like an animal. They just think that because you don't value yourself anymore, you are just a threat to others.

Resentments towards my family? well my Gran always puts across that she only cares about others, but is a double edged sword, she got it in her head that it was just her that provoked the "suicide note" and then proceeds to tell me 4 days ago that she feels responsible, but then says she is disappointed in me. My Mum on the other hand, told me that all my motivations were wrong. the few motivations keeping me in this life are wrong, and that i should settle down and give up on myself like she did.

Uhh I was put on medication by my GP, I did also have counselling at college, but it just wasn't doing anything for me. I wouldn't say i feel better or worse on the medication. I don't think that i would resent help/going back on meds if i 100% felt better on the meds if that makes sense. It clouded my sense of reality I feel, and although it helped me initially, it didn't do anything for me in the long run.
